# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037), [v1 c15 P67](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0067)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c38 P49](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0049)</sub>
- **Role:** Doctor  <sub>[v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018), [v5 c31 P26](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0026)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, broad-shouldered boy and man with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a teasing smile. As a youth he was considered very handsome. In his adult years, he retains a manly appearance with clear, straightforward eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Gilbert is clever, ambitious, determined, and popular. Though he teases girls in his youth, he possesses a strong sense of humor, good nature, and chivalry. He is steadfastly loyal, stubborn when doing what he perceives as his duty, and deeply devoted to Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v4 c29 P37](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0037), [v4 c29 P38](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0038)_

- To become a doctor and get the best out of life  <sub>[v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013)</sub>

## History

When Gilbert returned to Avonlea school after a summer trip, he tried to get Anne Shirley's attention by picking up her red braid and calling her 'Carrots', leading Anne to break her slate over his head and hold a grudge against him for years despite his immediate apology. Although Anne ignored him, Gilbert kept up a fierce but good-natured academic rivalry with her at Avonlea and Queen's Academy, where he won the medalist award. After Queen's, he surrendered his offered teaching position at Avonlea to Anne so she could stay near Green Gables, prompting Anne to forgive him and become his close friend. Gilbert taught at White Sands before attending Redmond College, where he served as Freshman Class president, studied medicine, and graduated with high honors. After being rejected by Anne on his first marriage proposal, he suffered a near-fatal bout of typhoid fever before she ultimately realized her feelings and accepted him. Upon marrying Anne, Gilbert moved to Four Winds to take over the medical practice of his great-uncle, Dr. David Blythe, and later settled at Ingleside, where he raised six children while practicing medicine.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003), [v1 c38 P37](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0037), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050), [v1 c38 P60](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0060), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c20 P44](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0044), [v3 c20 P48](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0048), [v3 c39 P23](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0023), [v3 c40 P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 c40 P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025), [v4 c1 P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c3 P15](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0015), [v5 c3 P17](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0017), [v5 c4 P62](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0062), [v5 c31 P26](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0026)_
